parts.name: arm strip 0

physics.Basic_description: A long, slender brown wooden arm with a smooth finish, forming the upper stationary part of the tongs.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the rigid structural backbone against which the moving arm presses to grip objects.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the mid-section of the wooden strip with parallel jaws to stabilize the tool.
physics.reason: Wooden tong arms are typically carved from solid wood stock for stiffness and durability.

parts.description: A long, slender brown wooden arm with a smooth finish, forming the upper stationary part of the tongs.

parts.name: spring clip

physics.Basic_description: A small silver metallic band or clip located at the very tip of the handle end.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a pivot pin or spring mechanism to join the two wooden arms and provide restoring force.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and critical for articulation to be grasped directly; avoid contact here.
physics.reason: Small metal fasteners and clips in hand tools are solid wire or sheet metal components.

parts.description: A small silver metallic band or clip located at the very tip of the handle end.

parts.name: arm strip 1

physics.Basic_description: A long, slender brown wooden arm matching the fixed arm, forming the lower movable part of the tongs.
physics.Functional_description: Flexes inward when squeezed to clamp objects between its tip and the fixed arm.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the handle area or mid-shaft to actuate the closing mechanism or lift the tool.
physics.reason: Like the fixed arm, this is a solid piece of wood designed to flex elastically.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
